Scaffold a new data source

Source: R/register_source.R
add_source_wizard.Rd

One-call scaffolder for adding a source family without editing the package. It writes, under root (default EHR_EXTERNAL_CONFIG_ROOT):

Usage

add_source_wizard(
  name,
  root = NULL,
  select_id_cols = NULL,
  time_origin = NULL,
  time_diff = "timestamp_minutes",
  id_cols = NULL,
  cohort_key = NULL,
  cohort_seed_tables = NULL,
  cohort_filter = NULL,
  id_prefixes = NULL,
  icu_id_type = "bigint",
  demo_row_limit = 1000L,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  register = TRUE
)

Arguments

name

Family name, e.g. "amsterdam".

root

Target config directory. Defaults to EHR_EXTERNAL_CONFIG_ROOT; created if it does not exist.

select_id_cols, time_origin, time_diff, id_cols, cohort_key, cohort_seed_tables, id_prefixes, icu_id_type

Registry fields (see register_source()). Required fields left NULL (select_id_cols, time_origin, id_cols, cohort_key) are written as null placeholders for you to fill in; optional ones are omitted.

cohort_filter

Declarative cohort spec (list with diag_table, code_col, key, optional split_commas/strip_dots).

demo_row_limit

Row cap for the <name>_demo variant. Default 1000.

overwrite

Overwrite an existing sources/<name>.json? Default FALSE.

register

Register the source this session when the spec is valid? Default TRUE.

Value

Invisibly, a list with root, json (registry path), created (paths written), registered (logical), and problems (spec problems, if any, that blocked registration).

Details

  • sources/<name>.json — a registry skeleton (fed to register_source()).

  • sql/<name>/… — the SQL directory tree (db_setup_sqls/schema, raw_mods, concepts_sqls/{flat,ts,dur,ehr}) with skeleton create_tables.sql, window_tables.sql, and indexes.sql.

  • rendehr_concepts_config.csv — a header-only concept config (created only if absent), where source-specific concept rows are added.

Existing files are never clobbered unless overwrite = TRUE. When the supplied fields form a complete, valid spec the source is also registered for the current session (register = TRUE); an incomplete skeleton is written but not registered, and the missing fields are reported.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
add_source_wizard("my_icu", root = "~/data/my_icu",
                  select_id_cols = c("patient_id", "admission_id", "stay_id"))
} # }
